paper_title: Guided Search Strategies in Non-Serializable Environments with   Applications to Software Engineering Agents
caption: : Critic learns to distinguish successful and unsuccessful trajectories for GPT-4o.

model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates how the “Average critic score” evolves over relative time for four trajectory categories, separating successful versus unsuccessful trajectories and comparing a “GPT-4o policy” to a “GPT-4o policy + 1-step lookahead.” The x-axis is labeled “Time (relative)” on a linear scale, starting at 0.0 and extending to just under 1.0 (data shown through approximately 0.95), with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. The y-axis is labeled “Average critic score” on a linear scale, ranging from about 0.2 up to about 0.85, with major ticks spaced by 0.1. The solid green line (GPT-4o policy, successfull) begins near 0.32 at time 0.0, rises quickly to about 0.43 by ~0.05, then stays near ~0.48–0.51 for much of the midrange (e.g., around ~0.49 near 0.2–0.35 and around ~0.50–0.51 near ~0.6–0.8), before increasing late to roughly ~0.54 at ~0.85, ~0.60 at ~0.9, and ending around ~0.71 near ~0.95. The solid red line (GPT-4o policy, unsuccessfull) starts around ~0.26 at 0.0, drops to roughly ~0.22 by ~0.1, and then remains fairly flat with small fluctuations around ~0.23–0.24 across the remainder of the time axis, ending near ~0.23 at ~0.95. The dashed green line (GPT-4o policy + 1-step lookahead, successfull) starts around ~0.30 at 0.0, increases to about ~0.41 by ~0.05 and to ~0.48–0.49 by ~0.2, then continues a steady upward trend through mid and late times (about ~0.55 near ~0.35, ~0.60 near ~0.5, ~0.65 near ~0.6, ~0.72 near ~0.8), ending near ~0.84–0.85 close to ~0.95. The dashed red line (GPT-4o policy + 1-step lookahead, unsuccessfull) begins near ~0.26 at 0.0, dips to about ~0.23 by ~0.05, then gradually rises across time (approximately ~0.28 near ~0.2, ~0.33 near ~0.35–0.4, ~0.36–0.38 near ~0.6–0.75 with a small dip around ~0.8), ending around ~0.41 at ~0.95.
